verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair question for an email marketing platform, but the evidence shows no recurring schedule. "Send your emails when the time is right" points to one-off send timing at most, and the API's "Start an automation for a specific contact" is a one-off trigger, not a recurring schedule. Neither counts toward recurring jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
